children: Foresight News posted on X (formerly Twitter). According to on-chain monitoring by Lookonchain, the GOLD team is suspected of carrying out a rug pull after 15 newly created wallets linked to the team sold all 224.5 million GOLD tokens.
The wallets reportedly received 3,178 SOL in return, worth about $330,000, and made a profit of $312,000.

title: GOLD Team Allegedly Sells 224.5 Million Tokens Through 15 Wallets in Suspected Rug Pull
